defect_observations.observation: Roulette wording calls 1-Phi(19/sqrt360)~0.1583 'the source approximation'; the held source (PDF p.153, printed 145) only evaluates the sigma-replaced threshold 1 giving 0.1587. The source variant is preserved in the next clause, so this is an attribution-wording imprecision, not a coverage failure.

Handbook gives ~0.1084 for Example 4.8.10; the held source prints 0.1083 (PDF p.269, printed 261). The handbook value is the correct rounding of the identical exact expression, but the discrepancy with the source is not remarked.

Real-index extension of the random-index theorem is asserted 'by the same estimates'; annex lines 766-769 justify it only by a two-sentence sequential-criterion remark and do not restate the hypotheses for the real-indexed family. Accepted as an application of the proved sequence theorem along every t_k->infinity; wording follows the 'similarly' pattern and could be made explicit.

Renewal proof applies the random-index theorem with a_t=floor(t/mu) but displays the normalization sigma sqrt(t/mu) without writing the deterministic rescaling a_t/(t/mu)->1 via the perturbation lemma.
'A_k in F_{L wedge k}' is asserted without its one-line verification.
Lemma 3.4.3 is proved by telescoping rather than the source's induction (PDF p.152); same decomposition, and the product-comparison route of Theorem 3.4.2 is retained.
Locator 'Section 3.4, pp. 144--161' omits printed p.143 (PDF p.151) where the Section 3.4 heading and opening sentence appear; every numbered source item lies within pp.144-161.
